technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive trend confirmation, but momentum indicators lack conviction and MACD remains bearish, limiting high-probability entry setup.

fundamental.summary: AKAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 14 days with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (342+ days old) with only sales and no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (395.68), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 14 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AKAM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku above cloud provides structural bullish confirmation, while extreme fear (28/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 14 days combined with crisis VIX, negative MACD momentum, overbought Williams %R, Bollinger Band squeeze, and unfavorable macro (rising dollar, flat yield curve) create excessive risk that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but this is severely undermined by earnings in 14 days, crisis-level VIX, negative MACD momentum, and overbought conditions near resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with crisis VIX (395.68) and unfavorable macro environment (rising dollar, flat yield curve) creates uncompensated tail risk that negates technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AKAM position plus 14 open IT positions (high sector concentration) further reduce conviction; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows flexibility but earnings proximity and macro headwinds argue for patience.
